main.description: A persistent stage identity that can be followed and linked across event editions. Its repository owns this profile; event places own their separate event-specific presentation.

createdAt.description: Client-declared timestamp when this record was created. Preserved through profile edits.

description.description: A public description of the persistent stage.

links.description: Public links for the stage, in preferred display order.

media.description: Media for this stage profile, in preferred display order. Event places do not inherit these values automatically.

name.description: The public name of the persistent stage.
